senses.gloss: SV0115 जीर्णं अश्नियात jīrṇaṁ aśniyāta Another meal should be consumed after the previous food is get digested completely, this make easier to digest the food.

SV0114 जीर्णावस्था jīrṇāvasthā The organic process of growing older and showing the effects of increasing age.i,e.after 60 years is considered as age of growing older. During this period body tissues, sense organ, strength, energy, virility, etc, goes down. This is the stage of Vata predominance.
